division_pattern: state → place (optional county ancestor); statistical CDPs excluded by LSAD
jurisdiction_generation_rule: One municipality jurisdiction per governing place
identifier_rule: Replace ocd-division with ocd-jurisdiction and append /government
known_exception_classes: Place/cousub name collisions; council districts belong to parent; form-of-government differences stay metadata

jurisdiction_generation_rule: One general-government jurisdiction per governing county-equivalent
known_exception_classes: Parish/borough/equivalent names; statistical census areas; consolidated city-counties route to AR-005

jurisdiction_generation_rule: One school-system jurisdiction per governing school district
known_exception_classes: Denver, Seattle, and Clark County district targets also passed; exact master selection handles local-mirror lag.

division_pattern: Multi-county or special-district boundary; may not exist in current Census/OCD place-county pipeline
jurisdiction_generation_rule: One transit-authority jurisdiction per legal authority
identifier_rule: Target-locked project OCD ID + Census PID6/GIDID when upstream OCD is absent
known_exception_classes: BART also passed; upstream OCD gaps use narrow Census-backed project overrides; maintainer approval applies only to optional upstream submission.

division_pattern: Coextensive place + county divisions linked by maintained alias
jurisdiction_generation_rule: One canonical government; prevent duplicate place and county jurisdictions
identifier_rule: Canonical place division plus maintained county alias/crosswalk
known_exception_classes: San Francisco and Broomfield also passed; canonical aliases and duplicate-ancestor suppression are required.

division_pattern: Port, water, park, fire, or other special boundary
jurisdiction_generation_rule: One special-purpose jurisdiction per legal authority
identifier_rule: Exact upstream OCD when present; otherwise target-locked Census-backed project override
validated_fixtures: FX-007 — Port of Seattle (MB100-042; packet staged in Scale Readiness)
known_exception_classes: OCD coverage varies; legal authority and Census function evidence must remain explicit.

division_pattern: Consolidated metro government that may not be strictly coextensive with one Census place and county
jurisdiction_generation_rule: One canonical government with maintained place/county aliases
identifier_rule: Canonical upstream OCD division plus alias/crosswalk rule
validated_fixtures: FX-008 — Metropolitan Government of Nashville and Davidson County (MB100-043; packet staged in Scale Readiness)
known_exception_classes: Retained county offices, urban-service districts, and naming differences remain explicit.
